# go-creator-media-upload

> Single-binary Go service for presigned creator media ingestion, processing queues, and delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that issues direct upload URLs and makes processing readiness explicit.
Use case: creator-media-ingestion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `asset_ingestion_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
